title: Add localStorage-backed queue + feedback (token generation, live queue display, staff call/complete)

requirements.text: Add a frontend-only “Local Storage Mode” that persists queue data and feedback data in browser localStorage, so the app can run without depending on backend canister APIs for these functions.

quotes: Use local storage to store queue data and feedback.

acceptanceCriteria: A single, clearly labeled toggle or configuration option exists to run queue + feedback using localStorage (instead of canister calls).
When Local Storage Mode is enabled, joining/leaving/serving queue and submitting/viewing feedback work end-to-end even if the backend actor is unavailable.
All localStorage keys are namespaced (e.g., "sqfm:") and versioned to allow future migrations.
Local data is loaded on app start and reflected in the UI without requiring a page refresh.

requirements.text: Implement token generation for queue entries in Local Storage Mode: each service queue entry receives a human-friendly token number that increments per service and is displayed consistently across user and staff/admin views.

quotes: Features should include token generation, live queue display, next customer call, service completion...

acceptanceCriteria: When a user joins a service queue in Local Storage Mode, they are assigned the next token number for that service (monotonically increasing).
The user can see their token number in the Queue page alongside their position/status.
The Admin/Staff queue table shows token numbers for entries in Local Storage Mode.
Token counters persist across reloads via localStorage (per service).

requirements.text: Add a live queue display experience in Local Storage Mode that mirrors the current canister-backed behavior: users can see their position/status update automatically and staff can see the current queue list update automatically.

quotes: Features should include ... live queue display ...

acceptanceCriteria: In Local Storage Mode, the Queue page updates the displayed position/status without manual refresh (polling or event-based update is acceptable).
In Local Storage Mode, the Admin/Staff queue list updates when entries are added/served/completed/no-show/cancelled without requiring a full page reload.
If localStorage is cleared or corrupted, the UI falls back to a safe empty state with clear user-facing messaging in English.

requirements.text: In Local Storage Mode, add staff controls for “Next customer call” and “Service completion” aligned to the existing admin workflow, ensuring the next waiting token can be called and then marked completed/served.

quotes: Features should include ... next customer call, service completion ...

acceptanceCriteria: In Local Storage Mode, the Admin/Staff view can call the next customer (advances the queue by selecting the oldest waiting entry).

After calling next, staff can mark the called entry as completed/served via an explicit action (or via an equivalent flow if call-next immediately serves, then UI must clearly represent ‘served/completed’ state).
Queue entry statuses in Local Storage Mode support at least: waiting, served/completed, cancelled, no-show (matching the UI expectations).
The user’s position/status updates appropriately when entries ahead are served/completed/no-show/cancelled.

requirements.text: Persist feedback submissions (rating + optional comment) in localStorage in Local Storage Mode, and make them reviewable from the Admin/Staff feedback list UI for the selected service.

quotes: ...and a feedback form with rating and comments. Use local storage to store queue data and feedback.

acceptanceCriteria: In Local Storage Mode, submitting feedback stores rating (1–5), comment text, timestamp, and associated service identifier in localStorage.
The existing feedback success/receipt UI still appears after successful local submission.
In Local Storage Mode, the Admin/Staff feedback review tab lists locally stored feedback for the selected service and sorts newest-first (or clearly documented order).
Input validation remains: service required, rating required and constrained to 1–5; comment optional.

requirements.text: Add developer-facing documentation explaining Local Storage Mode, including the localStorage schema/keys, how tokens are generated, and how to manually reset local data for testing.

quotes: Provide full source code with clear explanation

acceptanceCriteria: A documentation file is added to the repo describing Local Storage Mode behavior and data model (keys, example payloads, and status meanings).
Documentation includes steps to clear/reset local queue + feedback data from within the app UI and/or via browser devtools.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or anything in frontend/src/components/ui; compose them instead.
Keep the backend as a single Motoko actor (backend/main.mo); do not introduce additional backend services.
All user-facing text added/changed must be in English.
nonGoals: Do not rewrite the application as a non-React plain HTML/CSS/JavaScript site; implement the requested behavior within the existing React + TypeScript app.
Do not remove or replace Internet Identity authentication; Local Storage Mode may operate without backend calls, but existing auth paths should remain intact.
Do not change existing canister-backed queue/feedback behavior unless required to add the Local Storage Mode toggle/configuration.
